prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1002; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at an intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained significant injuries and is pursuing a claim for the losses resulting from this incident. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also provide the name of the adjuster assigned to this claim and the claim number.

Your insured and your company have a duty to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, witness statements, repair and total-loss records, recorded statements, and any internal investigation materials. Please ensure that none of this evidence is altered, repaired, discarded, or destroyed while this claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
